summary: The knowledge-mode dossiers are broadly accurate on roster, coach, owner, arena funding, record, Cup and marquee facts, all of which agree with CURRENT FACTS. Real errors were the pinwheel designer (Cooney, corrected to Frank Glickman, confirmed live), the downtown Nike store (closed late 2023, reopened Nov 2025 at 638 SW 5th Ave), Deadstock Coffee location (moved to The Hoxton), a Spirit of 77 neighborhood mismatch, a Camara and Holiday trade line, and a claim that the Blazers are the only major-league basketball team in the state. The Nike Hoop Summit at Moda Center was confirmed live for April 2026. The brief needs three fixes (White Stag timing, the Cooney verify item, and hedging on the Nike downtown channel and 1977 Classic Edition). Remaining risk sits in small-business, date and licensing claims.
